description: LOWELL, Mass (Oct. 18, 2018) – Congressman Joe Kennedy III today endorsed Lori Trahan, Democrat for Congress in the Third District, at a Downtown Lowell rally. Kennedy, a third term representative from the Fourth District, told the crowd that Trahan represents the ideals of American democracy. “On November 6, people in this district and across […]

title: Representative Lori Trahan Congresswoman Lori Trahan was born and raised in a working-class family in Lowell, Massachusetts. She is the mom of two young girls and proudly represents Massachusetts' 3rd Congressional District.
